chapter.verse: Tu-a teng khit ciangin Athens khua pan Paul paikhia-in Corinth khua tung hi.

Tua takah Pontus khua-a suak, Aquila minnei Jew mi khat tawh kituak kha hi. Amah pen Jew mi khempeuh Rome khuapi pan paikhia ding cih Claudius' thupiakna hangin nung deuhin a zi Priscilla tawh Italy gam pan a na tung ahi hi. Amau tawh kimu dingin Paul va pai a,
nasep a nam kibang uh ahih manin Paul zong amau' kiangah omin nasem hi. A hang pen sumzonna ah amaute puanbuk bawlte ahi uh hi.
Tua ciangin Paul in Sabbath nisimin vengkhawm inn ah thu kikuppih a, Jew mite leh Greek mite pawlzot ding hanciam hi.
Macedonia gam pan Silas leh Timothy a tun ciangin Paul zong Pasian' thu pulakna bek sem a, Khris pen Jesu hi ci-in Jew mite' tungah khauhtakin teci pang hi.

Amaute in Paul langpangin a kobawl uh ciangin Paul in a puantual singkhia-in amaute' kiangah, “Nomau' sisan nomau' lutang tungah tu ta hen! Mawh ka peng ta a, tu-a kipan Gentile mite' kiangah ka pai ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin tua mun nusia-in Titius Justus minnei, Pasian a bia Gentile mi khat' inn ah pai hi. Tua inn pen vengkhawm inn tawh a kiveng ahi hi.
Vengkhawm ukpa Crispus in ama' innkuanpih bup tawh Topa um a, Paul' thugen a za Corinth khuami tampitak in zong thu umin kibaptize uh hi.
Zan khat, Topa in muhtuam khat tawh Paul hopih a, “Lau kei in. Na thugen zomsuak inla gamdai kei in.
A hang pen nang kong ompih a, hih khua ah keima' mi tampi nei ka hih manin kuamah in nang hong nawk zolo-in hong liamsuah zolo ding hi,” ci hi
Paul zong kum khat leh kha guk taam a, amaute' kiangah Pasian' thu hilhcian hi.
Ahih hangin Achaia gam ah Gallio, tualsung mangpa a suah ciangin Jew mite kithukhatin Paul langpang uh a, thukhenna tual ah thatang kaihin,
“Hih mipa in thukhun tawh kilehbulhin Pasian bia dingin mite pawlzot hi,” ci uh hi.

Ahih hangin Paul kamka ding a kipat laitak Gallio in Jew mite' kiangah, “Jew mite aw, hih pen khutkhialhna thu, ahihkeileh a suksia haitatna thu ahih takpi leh na lungkim loh thu uh kong santheih ahi hi.
Ahi zongin tu-a pen kampau, min, leh nomau' thukhun cihte tawh kisai kinialna vai ahih manin nomaumah in na vaihawm un. Hih thute ah thukhen sep ding ka ut kei hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin tua mite thukhenna tual pan hawlkhia hi.
Tua mite in zong a vekun vengkhawm ukpa Sosthenes man uh a, thukhenna tual mai-ah sat uh hi. Himah taleh Gallio in hih thute khat zong awlmawh lo hi.

Tua zawh ni tampitak Paul taambeh a, tua khit ciangin sanggamte mangpha khakin tembaw tawh Syria gam zuan hi. Priscilla leh Aquila zong amah tawh om uh hi. Paul in kiciamna a neihsa bangin tembaw khawlna Cenchrea ah sam a met khin ahi hi.
Tua ciangin amaute Ephesus khua tung uh a, Paul in tua takah Aquila leh Priscilla nusia-in amah ahihleh vengkhawm inn ah pai-in Jew mite tawh thu kikum hi.
Amaute in Paul a taambeh nading a khoh uh hangin Paul in mang lo-in
amaute mangpha khak a, “Pasian' deihna a om leh note' kiangah kong paikik ding hi,” ci hi. Tua ciangin Ephesus pan tembaw tawh zinkhia hi.
Caesarea khua a tun ciangin Paul paito-in pawlpi va hopih a, tua ciangin Antioch khua ah paisuk hi.
Tua takah tawlkhat a taam khit ciangin zinkhia a, Galatia leh Phrygia gamke sung teng a banbanin nawkin nungzuite thakhauhsak hi.
Tu-in Alexandria khuami, Apollos minnei Jew mi khat Ephesus khua tung hi. Amah pen thugen a siam, Pasian' Laibupi a theitel mi khat ahi hi.
Topa' Lampi thu tawh limtak a kipantah khat hi a, John ii baptizena thu bek thei ahih hangin kha sung lawp mahmahna tawh thugenin Jesu' thu kitel sinsenin hilh hi.
Vengkhawm ah hangtak thugen kipan a, ahi zongin Priscilla leh Aquila in Apollos' thugen a zak uh ciangin amah samkhia-in Pasian' Lampi thu a kicianzaw-in gentel uh hi.

Achaia gamke sung teng Apollos a zinnop ciangin sanggamte in thapia uh a, amah a na muak nadingun nungzuite lai khak uh hi. Apollos a tun ciangin hehpihna hangin thu a na um khin mite nakpi-in panpih hi.
A hang pen Apollos in Pasian' Laibupi siksanin Khris pen Jesu hi ci-in milak ah Jew mite khauhtak dawngkik hi.
